title: Garbage Truck Suburban Neighborhood Trash Pickup
author: loganzsound
changes: A real garbage truck on a suburban street, its reversing alarm going 'beep… beep… beep' over the rumbling engine. Trimmed to 20.80–23.70 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3. Taken from the Freesound high-quality MP3 preview of the recording (AT897 and Zoom H5).
